purpose: Calibration corpus for the Scoring agent. Retrieval over these cases grounds each new fit-score judgment. Note: fit_score measures lead quality at intake time; outcome can still diverge (e.g. HIST-003 lost on price despite high fit). The scorer is evaluated on ranking quality (Precision@20), not on predicting every single outcome.

axes: A1 product-spec match against catalog (throughput, format, industry application)
A2 company profile: industry, size band, production site in serviceable region
A3 buying-stage signals: timeline, budget, replacement of existing machine, plant project
A4 contact quality: role/authority, corporate domain vs freemail, signature completeness
A5 disqualifiers: student/thesis, supplier pitch, competitor probe, private one-off, spec far outside range

cases.inquiry_text: Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren, für unsere Feinkost-Produktion (zwei Linien, Gläser in Umkartons) suchen wir einen Kartonaufrichter, ca. 18 Kartons/min, FEFCO 0201, Inbetriebnahme Q3. Bitte um Angebot und Terminvorschlag für eine Besichtigung. Mit freundlichen Grüßen, T. Marek, Produktionsleiter
cases.justification: A1: 18/min within PFS-CE 240 capacity (24/min), FEFCO 0201 exact match. A2: food manufacturer, 140 employees, DE. A3: named commissioning quarter and asked for site visit = active project. A4: Produktionsleiter on corporate domain. No disqualifiers.

cases.inquiry_text: We are a pharmaceutical contract packer. Looking for a carton sealer suitable for GMP environment, stainless steel, tape sealing, approx. 10 cartons/min, with IQ/OQ documentation.
cases.justification: A1: PFS-CS 180 GMP stainless option with IQ/OQ package is an exact catalog match; 10/min well within 18/min. A2: pharma co-packer, target industry. A3: requirement precisely specified = advanced evaluation stage. A4: senior role, corporate domain.

cases.inquiry_text: Anfrage Wrap-Around-Packer für 0,5l-PET, 28 Takte/min, Austausch Bestandsanlage. Budget vorhanden, Entscheidung bis August.
cases.loss_reason: price: competitor Cartomac S.r.l. approx. 22% below offer
cases.justification: A1: 28 cycles/min within PFS-WA 320 capacity (32/min), PET bottles supported. A2/A3: beverage producer, replacement project with budget and deadline. High score was correct at intake; loss was a commercial outcome, not a scoring error. Lesson: flag price-sensitive buyers (explicit budget comparison language) for early value argumentation.

cases.inquiry_text: Hallo, ich schreibe meine Bachelorarbeit über Verpackungsautomatisierung und würde Ihnen gerne ein paar Fragen zu Ihren Maschinen und Preisen stellen. Können Sie mir Datenblätter und eine Preisliste schicken?
cases.justification: A5 disqualifier: thesis research, no company, freemail, asks for price list without application. Polite template decline; no sales effort.

cases.inquiry_text: Sehr geehrter Einkauf, wir sind Hersteller von Bandstahl und Blechzuschnitten und würden Sie gerne als Lieferant beliefern. Anbei unser Katalog.
cases.loss_reason: not a lead: inbound supplier pitch
cases.justification: A5 disqualifier: vendor selling to us, not a buyer. Route to purchasing, remove from sales pipeline.

cases.inquiry_text: FachPack badge scan. Note field: 'case erector? will send carton sizes'. No phone. Company field: 'Convertis Lebensmittel'.
cases.justification: A1 thin at intake (product category only, no specs). A2 strong after enrichment: food manufacturer, 180 employees. A3: fair conversation implies active interest. Same-day follow-up with format questionnaire converted it. Lesson: fair leads with a product note + target industry deserve medium-high despite missing specs, IF followed up fast.

cases.inquiry_text: Hi! We're building a vegan snack brand and want to automate our carton packing. Currently doing ~2 cartons/min by hand. What would a machine cost? We're a small team of 3.
cases.loss_reason: no budget; machine economics not viable at 2 cartons/min
cases.justification: A1: real application but volume far below economic threshold for EUR 34k+ machinery. A2: 3-person startup, no register entry. A4: freemail founder. Genuine but premature; nurture list, not pipeline.

cases.inquiry_text: We urgently need two palletizing cells for our new fulfilment hall (go-live before peak season). Approx. 550 cases/h each, cases up to 32 kg, Euro pallets, MES integration via OPC UA. Please send offer and earliest delivery.
cases.justification: A1: 550 cases/h and 32 kg within PFS-PAL 600 spec (600/h, 40 kg), OPC UA standard. A2: fulfilment, 380 employees. A3: hard deadline (peak season), two cells, new hall = funded project. A4: engineering lead. Textbook high-fit.

cases.inquiry_text: Guten Tag, bitte senden Sie mir Ihre komplette Preisliste aller Maschinen inklusive aller Optionen sowie technische Zeichnungen und Ersatzteilpreise. Es eilt.

buyer_company.name: undisclosed (later matched to competitor employee via public profile)

cases.justification: A5 disqualifier pattern: full price list + drawings + spare part prices, zero application detail, urgency without context, freemail, no company. Classic competitive probe; send only public brochure.

cases.inquiry_text: Wir benötigen einen Kartonaufrichter für 60 Kartons/min für unsere neue Molkerei-Linie. Bitte um kurzfristiges Angebot.
cases.loss_reason: requirement 60/min exceeds PFS-CE 240 maximum of 24/min; referred to high-speed specialist
cases.justification: A2/A3/A4 all strong, but A1 is a hard mismatch: 60/min is 2.5x above catalog maximum. Spec ceiling caps the score regardless of company quality. Honest referral preserved goodwill.

cases.inquiry_text: Grüß Gott, wir suchen für unsere Braumanufaktur einen Kartonverschließer, ca. 8-10 Kartons/min, Klebeband, für Geschenkkartons. Angebot und Referenzen aus der Getränkebranche wären super.
cases.justification: A1: 8-10/min tape sealing = PFS-CS 180 core use case. A2: smaller size band (60) but target industry, AT serviceable. A3: asks for references = comparison stage. A4: owner-level contact. Solid mid-high fit.

cases.inquiry_text: Wir machen Ihre Marke sichtbar! Performance-Marketing für Maschinenbauer. 30 Minuten Erstgespräch gefällig?
cases.justification: A5 disqualifier: agency selling services through the contact form. No response required.
